newsitem.title: INDIA: India to set up power regulatory bodies.
newsitem.headline: India to set up power regulatory bodies.

text.p: The Indian cabinet on Tuesday approved a proposal to set up electricity regulatory bodies at federal and state levels for fixing power tariffs, a government statement said.

"The cabinet has approved the proposal for setting up a Central Electricity Regulatory Commission and State Electricity Regulatory Commissions for fixation of tariffs and other incidental matters," the statement said.
It said a bill for setting up of these commissions is expected to be introduced in the parliament during the current monsoon season.
The statement did not give any other details.
